read_request_body_json: read a FastAPI request body and parse it as a JSON dictionary with fallback decoding
get_form_data: extract form data from a FastAPI request and handle OpenAI SDK bracket notation keys
extract_nested_form_metadata: extract nested metadata from form data using bracket notation like litellm_metadata[key][subkey]
get_tags_from_request_body: extract tags from request body metadata and request body tags fields
populate_request_with_path_params: copy FastAPI path params and query params into the request payload dictionary
